# Dropped calls (generated by `node tools/scenegen/report.mjs --dropped`; do not edit)

Every call the converter accepts without turning it into a scene op (stub class or method, host method that emits nothing, block-entity class the converter cannot decide, a no-op override, a note) is recorded per scene and classified here.
Classes: `cosmetic` (rendering/audio/debug only), `metadata` (scene fields: title, keyframes), `getter` (returns a handle, no state), `link-binding` (binds an element link; the element itself is emitted with its `out` id), `legit-empty` (Java also does nothing: the instanceof test fails, the selection holds no matching block, or the value already equals the requested one; each case is listed below with its evidence), `state` (state-affecting and visible: must be zero).

Totals: 2326 recorded events over 169 scenes; metadata 804, cosmetic 150, legit-empty 1188, getter 183, link-binding 1; unclassified 0; state-affecting 0.

## Classes

| class | meaning |
|---|---|
| `cosmetic` | no effect on scene state or on the timeline: particles, audio, rendering path, debug |
| `metadata` | not a timeline element: the value is a SceneJson field (title, keyframes) |
| `getter` | returns a handle or value; the state change, if any, is a separate recorded op |
| `link-binding` | binds an element link to the element created by an earlier op (emitted with its out id) |
| `legit-empty` | Java also changes nothing here: the instanceof test fails, the selection holds no matching block or value, or the value already equals the requested one (evidence in the detail column) |
| `state` | state-affecting and visible: must be zero (it would have to become an op or a Call) |
